# The reference MuJoCo for fitting and training: 4.0.1, the version the browser build
# (web/, @mujoco/mujoco 4.0.1) runs.
#
# Installed by env/setup_mujoco_401.sh with:
#   pip install --require-hashes --no-deps -r env/requirements-mujoco-401.txt
# --no-deps is deliberate: this list IS the closure. mujoco 4.0.1 also declares
# mujoco-studio (a viewer); the simulacrum never imports it and runs without it.

# Linux x86_64 (manylinux_2_28; the GPU host's container is Debian 12, glibc 2.36) and macOS arm64,
# CPython 3.11 and 3.12.
